title: 你不可能迅速提升吸引力丨吸引力的构成

timeline.summary: Using a hypothetical question to Ma Yun about becoming rich quickly, he argues that attraction cannot be transformed instantly and must be built gradually.
He divides attraction into external and internal value, defining external value as visible resources and presentation that affect whether a meeting can happen.
He says grooming, clothing and income can improve external value comparatively quickly, while what he calls real attraction or internal value changes slowly.
He describes internal value as intangible but quickly perceived and uses it to explain his claim that people decide how to treat a man within minutes.
He lists lack of fear, self-worth, confidence, security, deservingness, boundary expression and low neediness, then contrasts an abundant state with a scarce state.
